items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Do you remember Bob Lyons, the bass player? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, which of the boys that played blow themselves out once?

ctx.x: Who used to play a lot up here at the Eagle, by the Eagle Saloon, you know, where they... Yeah. On Rampart. And near Perdido Street. Perdido Street. Bob Lyons used to stay around there too. Do you remember Bob Lyons, the bass player?
Well, which of the boys that played blow themselves out once?
